scenes.event: Scarlett and her friends discuss naming her new red laptop.
scenes.description: Scarlett has just bought a new red laptop and wants to give it a meaningful name. She has gathered her friends Yuna and Cici in the living room to brainstorm ideas. The atmosphere is warm and lively, with everyone sharing their thoughts.

characters.name: Scarlett Castillo
characters.description: A 22-year-old student who is enthusiastic, creative, and thoughtful. She is eager to give her new laptop a name with personal and cultural significance.; Female / Student, 22 years old; Occupation: Student; Personality: Enthusiastic, Creative, Thoughtful; Values: Cultural significance, Personal expression, Balance; Interests: Technology, Art, Writing; Experiences: Buying a new computer, Organizing group discussions, Looking for a meaningful name, Academic writing
characters.position: Sitting on the couch, holding the laptop

characters.name: Yuna Kim
characters.description: A 23-year-old art student with a flair for symbolism and a love for mythology; Female; Age: 23; Occupation: Fine Arts Student specializing in mixed media; Personality: Imaginative, enthusiastic, introspective; Values: Creativity, authenticity, storytelling; Interests: Ancient myths, symbolic art, creative naming challenges; Experiences: Participated in a university art collective focused on mythological themes, won a local contest for her symbolic character design, recently collaborated on a mural project inspired by Korean folklore.
characters.position: Sitting across from Scarlett, leaning forward

characters.name: Cici Nguyen
characters.description: A 24-year-old engineering student who is pragmatic and analytical; Female; Age: 24; Occupation: Part-time robotics lab assistant; Personality: Analytical, pragmatic, curious; Values: Functionality, efficiency, intellectual growth; Interests: Coding, puzzle games, tech reviews; Experiences: Participated in a university engineering design competition, worked on a project to develop an automated recycling system, frequently collaborates on group tech projects with peers.
characters.position: Sitting on the floor with a notebook

actions.action: Opens the laptop and shows it to the group
actions.dialogue: Look at this beautiful red laptop! I want to name it something special, something that reflects who I am and what I do.

actions.action: Suggests a name with flame symbolism
actions.dialogue: How about 'Ignis'? It means fire in Latin. It's powerful and matches the red color perfectly.
I love the idea, but maybe something more straightforward? Like 'Redwood'? It's a strong name and it's also a type of tree, which is kind of a balance between creativity and function.
I like both of those. Ignis feels really symbolic, and Redwood is grounded and meaningful. I want something that represents my culture too.

actions.action: Suggests a name with cultural significance
actions.dialogue: What about 'Anahita'? It's a name from Persian mythology for a goddess of the sea and wisdom. It's beautiful and has a lot of meaning.

actions.action: Adds a note about the laptop's role in Scarlett's life
actions.dialogue: That's really cool, Yuna. But don't forget, this is a tool for your schoolwork and your writing too. It should be something you can connect with, but not too complicated.

actions.action: Decides on a name that balances both perspectives
actions.dialogue: You're both right. I want it to be meaningful but not too hard to remember. How about 'Rumi'? It's a nod to my heritage and the poet Rumi, and it also feels elegant and strong.

scenes.plot: Scarlett and her friends Yuna and Cici gather in the living room to discuss naming her new red laptop. Yuna suggests names with symbolic and mythical meanings, while Cici reminds her of the laptop's practical use. Scarlett ultimately chooses a name that reflects her cultural background and personal interests, finding a balance between creativity and functionality.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore how Scarlett's values and personality influence her decision-making process, while also showing how her friends contribute to the discussion in a supportive and collaborative way.

chunk.text: Scarlett's friends help her find a name for her new laptop that reflects her personal and cultural identity while also being practical.
